brief: Phone game screen, subtle and Zach Gage-inspired: flat, calm, one accent, controls in thumb reach. Same moment as round 01: move 9, you are White vs the Medium bot, the snails move after Black's next move, your snail is about to crush Black's bishop and Black's snail is 2 squares from your king.

candidates.name: Paper
candidates.concept: The most familiar layout made very quiet: warm paper, a flat board and one coral colour that only ever means snail danger.
candidates.typography: DM Sans 700 for names (16px), 500 for buttons (15px), 400 for status and moves (13–15px).
traits: Opponent above, you below the board, each with their snail distance
Countdown is three dots under the board
Big Undo / Moves / New buttons at the bottom

candidates.name: Big Number
candidates.concept: The countdown is the headline: one huge numeral tells you how many moves until the snails move, and the board shows exactly where they'll go.
candidates.typography: Manrope 800 at 112px for the numeral, 700 at 22px for its caption, 500 at 13–15px for everything else.
traits: Giant move counter above the board
Faint dotted paths for where snails have been, amber hops for where they go next
Moves live in a bottom sheet with the main buttons

candidates.name: Reach
candidates.concept: The board explains the danger by itself: a soft tint marks every square each snail can reach next, edge to edge on the screen.
candidates.typography: Figtree 800 for the numbers and title (21–26px), 500 for labels and tabs (12–15px).
traits: Edge-to-edge board with tinted snail reach zones
Two cards spell out both king distances with small meters
Bottom tab bar: Board, Moves, Undo, New
